role: the single checkpoint used to produce the submitted predictions
val_split: runs/splits/val.txt (699 labelled images, no overlap with train or test splits)
loader_note: written by a transformers 5 release; hyperseg_uav.model.translate_legacy_keys renames 628 backbone keys to the transformers 4 names before load_state_dict. Translation is in-memory only, so this hash stays valid.
note: No other checkpoint is part of the submission. models/hyperseg_resume_best.pt and the Swin-L H3 run exist in the development history but are not used here.
